organization.title: Organization Name
organization.description: The official name or title of the organization.

organizationUrl.title: Organization URL
organizationUrl.description: A URI linking to the website of the organization. Null indicates that no URL is available.

participation.title: Participation
participation.description: A list of periods of participation.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: The year or month in which the work experience began, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format.

startLabel.title: Start Date Label
startLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the work experience start date.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: The year or month in which the work experience ended, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format. Null indicates that the position is ongoing.

endLabel.title: End Date Label
endLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the work experience end date. Null indicates that the position is ongoing.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A summary of the volunteer experience.

description.title: Description
description.description: A list of statements describing the organization participation.

items.title: Description Statement
items.description: A statement describing the organization participation.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: A list of skills, technologies, tools, or areas of expertise used in the work experience.

items.description: A skill, technology, tool, or area of expertise.
